source: Starting-zone training, gathering tools and vendor prices supplied by the party.
recommendation: Learn Skinning plus Herbalism or Mining in your starting zone. The local profession trainers also sell gathering tools and materials bags.

checklist.text: Learn Skinning from a starting-zone trainer.
Choose and learn Herbalism or Mining.
Buy your gathering tools — 10 copper per tool.
Buy a materials bag — 25 copper per bag.

professions.name: Skinning
professions.description: Learn Skinning in your starting zone, alongside Herbalism or Mining. Skin eligible beasts after they have been looted as you follow the questing route.
steps: Visit a Skinning trainer in your starting zone.
Buy the gathering tool for 10 copper and a materials bag for 25 copper from the local profession trainers.
Loot beasts, then skin those that your current skill allows.

professions.name: Herbalism
professions.description: Pair Herbalism with Skinning if you want to collect herbs while questing. Gather nearby herb nodes along the group's route.
steps: Learn Herbalism from a starting-zone trainer.
Buy your gathering tool for 10 copper and a materials bag for 25 copper from the local profession trainers.
Collect herbs along the way, then rejoin the group.

professions.name: Mining
professions.description: Pair Mining with Skinning if you want to collect ore while questing. Gather nearby mineral nodes along the group's route.
steps: Learn Mining from a starting-zone trainer.
Buy your gathering tool for 10 copper and a materials bag for 25 copper from the local profession trainers.
Collect ore along the way, then rejoin the group.
